title: Hide and Seek
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig, this is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇，这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig
lines.zh: 小猪佩奇

lines.en: Hide and Seek
lines.zh: 捉迷藏

lines.en: Peppa and George are playing hide and seek. It is George's turn to hide.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治正在玩捉迷藏。现在轮到乔治躲起来了。

lines.en: He must quickly find somewhere to hide before Peppa finishes counting.
lines.zh: 他必须在佩奇数完之前赶紧找到地方躲起来。

lines.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven...
lines.zh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七……

lines.en: George has found somewhere to hide, just in time.
lines.zh: 乔治及时找到了藏身之处。

lines.en: Ready or not, here I come!
lines.zh: 准备好了吗，我来了！

lines.en: Peppa has to find where George is hiding.
lines.zh: 佩奇必须找到乔治藏身的地方。

lines.en: Found you!
lines.zh: 找到你了！

lines.en: Peppa has found George.
lines.zh: 佩奇找到了乔治。

lines.en: George, I could see you too easily!
lines.zh: 乔治，我太容易看到你了！

lines.en: Now it is Peppa's turn to hide.
lines.zh: 现在轮到佩奇躲起来了。

lines.en: One, um, three...
lines.zh: 一，嗯，三……

lines.en: I'll help George to count. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten...
lines.zh: 我来帮乔治数数。一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十……

lines.en: OK George, open your eyes!
lines.zh: 好的乔治，睁开你的眼睛！

lines.en: George has to find where Peppa is hiding.
lines.zh: 乔治必须找到佩奇藏身的地方。

lines.en: Oh!
lines.zh: 哦！

lines.en: Peppa isn't hiding under the table.
lines.zh: 佩奇并没有躲在桌子底下。

lines.en: George, have you thought of looking upstairs?
lines.zh: 乔治，你有没有想过上楼看看？

lines.en: Peppa isn't under the bed.
lines.zh: 佩奇不在床底下。

lines.en: What was that strange noise?
lines.zh: 那奇怪的声音是什么？

lines.en: Peppa isn't behind the curtain.
lines.zh: 佩奇不在幕后。

lines.en: There is that strange noise again. What can it be?
lines.zh: 又传来奇怪的声音。会是什么？

lines.en: George has found where Peppa was hiding.
lines.zh: 乔治找到了佩奇藏身的地方。

lines.en: George found me! Now it's Daddy's turn to hide.
lines.zh: 乔治找到了我！现在轮到爸爸躲起来了。

lines.en: Oh, I think George should have another turn.
lines.zh: 哦，我想乔治应该再轮一次。

lines.en: But George isn't very good at hiding.
lines.zh: 但是乔治不太擅长隐藏。

lines.en: I'm sure he'll be better this time.
lines.zh: 我相信他这次会更好。

lines.en: Close your eyes and start counting.
lines.zh: 闭上眼睛开始数。

lines.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten...
lines.zh: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九、十……

lines.en: Ready or not, here I come!
lines.zh: 不管准备好没，我来了！

lines.en: Oh, George isn't hiding under the table.
lines.zh: 哦，乔治没有躲在桌子底下。

lines.en: But George always hides under the table.
lines.zh: 但乔治总是躲在桌子底下。

lines.en: Have you thought of looking upstairs?
lines.zh: 有没有想过上楼看看？

lines.en: I know where he is.
lines.zh: 我知道他在哪里。

lines.en: George is in the toy basket.
lines.zh: 乔治在玩具篮里。

lines.en: Oh!
lines.zh: 哦！

lines.en: George is not in the toy basket. Where can he be?
lines.zh: 乔治不在玩具篮里。他会在哪里？

lines.en: Peppa cannot find George anywhere.
lines.zh: 佩奇在任何地方都找不到乔治。

lines.en: Daddy, I can't find George anywhere.
lines.zh: 爸爸，我到处都找不到乔治。

lines.en: Oh, dear! I wonder where he can be.
lines.zh: 噢，亲爱的！我想知道他会在哪里。

lines.en: Actually, I think there's something about George in this newspaper.
lines.zh: 事实上，我认为这份报纸上有一些关于乔治的事情。

lines.en: George! Found you!
lines.zh: 乔治！找到你了！

lines.en: Oh, George! That was a good place to hide.
lines.zh: 噢，乔治！那是一个躲藏的好地方。

lines.en: George was hiding behind Daddy Pig's newspaper all the time.
lines.zh: 乔治一直躲在猪爸爸的报纸后面。

lines.en: Peppa Pig!
lines.zh: 小猪佩奇！
